findings.description: When the ledger rejects an entry because the memo is too long, the transfer function has already updated the account balances, violating the spec which requires that both accounts and the ledger remain unchanged on ledger rejection.
findings.evidence: ledger.record raises ValueError after accounts[src] is decreased and accounts[dst] increased. The spec states that ledger rejection must leave both accounts and the ledger unchanged.

review.summary: Candidate fails to preserve atomicity when ledger.record rejects due to memo length > 40, leaving accounts modified.
